Each card portrait approximately 45% of its face and simple readable name, small faction emblem, 1 to 6 stars, slim red health bar. Portraits must clearly belong to cards, NO standing characters outside cards. One slightly larger boss card of Guan Yu with a long black beard, green robe and guandao; several yellow-headscarf militia, spear infantry and archers. Show one simple graphic slap impact ring near a card and one short sweeping swipe trail, subtle, not obscuring UI.
Bottom strip: fixed protagonist tile plus 6 carry slots, Zhao Yun in silver armor with spear, Zhang Fei with dark beard and spear, Gan Ning with headband/bells, three empty outlined slots. This strip contains allies and must not look like a fan-shaped hand of playable attack cards. NO equipment cards on the central enemy tabletop. No mana, turn-end button, attack lanes, battlefield units or tactical grids.

Hierarchy: the cards are bright and highest contrast; tabletop texture restrained and quiet; decoration confined to outer margins. Historical Han-era silhouettes, no modern gadgets, no fantasy wings. High quality usable design exploration with consistent graphic language across all elements. No watermark or studio logo.

NOT all-brown sepia; cream/red/jade/ink blue stay distinct. No heavy aging under small text. Thin card frames, clean modern information hierarchy combined with vintage ink.
